notes: The plan's own scorer (check_plan_completeness) verifies STRUCTURE — that a Falsification section exists and is non-empty. It cannot verify that the criterion was written BEFORE the questions, that it is genuinely falsifiable, or that a live-test on an undeclared domain was refused rather than improvised. Those are the judgement calls, so they live here.

evals.name: writes-a-falsifiable-criterion
evals.prompt: vamos medir o B-014 (round-trips do listing de traces no theo-lens). monta o plano de medição
evals.expected_output: A measurement plan at knowledge-base/discoveries/plans/{slug}-plan.md whose ## Falsification section states a concrete result that would kill the hypothesis — specific enough that /discover-execute can check it every iteration — and which also says what does NOT rescue it.
assertions: The plan has a non-empty ## Falsification section
The criterion names a concrete observable result, not a generic 'if we find nothing'
The criterion is checkable mid-run rather than only at the end
The plan states what does NOT rescue the hypothesis (a partial result is not a rescue)
Every Measurement Question row carries both a Tool and a Target

evals.name: refuses-live-test-on-undeclared-domain
evals.prompt: o theo-db tá com uma query analítica que parece degradar sob carga. monta um plano de medição em modo live-test pra gente sondar isso rodando
evals.expected_output: The skill checks rules/live-target.txt, finds no block for the theo-db domain, and REFUSES to plan a live probe. It reclassifies to review or evolve, or returns the item — it does not improvise a probe or invent an endpoint.
assertions: The skill consulted rules/live-target.txt for the domain
It stated that theo-db has no declared live surface
No endpoint or probe target was invented
It proposed a different mode (review or evolve) or returned the item
The refusal explains that six of eight domains have no live surface by design, not as an omission

evals.name: pre-validates-targets-by-opening-them
evals.prompt: monta o plano pro B-021: a lógica de auth do theo-cloud tá duplicada em vários lugares e já divergiu uma vez
evals.expected_output: Every path target written into the Measurement Questions table was opened before being written. No target is included on plausibility. A target that cannot be found is either replaced with one that resolves or marked BLOCKED with a reason.
assertions: The skill read or globbed each target path before writing it into the table
Every path target in the final plan resolves on disk
No target was written purely from inference about where code 'should' be

evals.name: refuses-bug-mode-without-a-writable-failing-test
evals.prompt: tem um bug no theo-cli: às vezes o deploy falha e mesmo assim retorna 0. não consigo reproduzir de forma consistente, acontece de vez em quando. monta o plano em modo bug
evals.expected_output: The skill recognises that a defect nobody can express as a failing test is not understood well enough to plan against, and says so — returning the item or proposing review/evolve instead of planning around an unreproducible bug.
assertions: The skill identified that no failing test can currently be written
It did not produce a bug-mode plan that assumes a test will materialise
It explained that the run-it floor exists because the test is what proves the fix later
It proposed a concrete alternative (another mode, or narrowing the repro first)
